mentions.name: Rebrain
mentions.description: This is a Reddit-like learning platform ('doom learning instead of doom scrolling'). Users upload a source, direct the kind of questions they want to be asked, and start answering; when they get answers wrong they can discuss the problem with AI. Users can also read other people's sources, questions, answers, and AI discussions, and join communities to share sources and questions when learning the same topic.
mentions.problem: Aims to counter doomscrolling by turning scrolling time into learning time.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I launched https://rebrain.gg/ a few days ago.

It's a bit like Reddit but focused on learning. (Doom learning instead of doom scrolling)

You 1) upload a source 2) direct the kind of questions you want to be asked 3) start answering (and if you get the answers wrong, you can discuss the problem with "AI").
